title: Recall: Count keys with the entry API
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

entry.clue: Given mutable counts: HashMap<&str, u32> and word: &str, write an expression selecting the word entry and inserting 0 only if absent. Use entry followed by or_insert.

increment.clue: Given count: &mut u32 from a map entry, write a complete statement adding 1 to the referenced value with +=. Include the semicolon.
